profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Software Engineer with technical skills in Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, React and a focus on flexible design that allows the product to develop and grow with continued development.

+ Built applications that solve real-world problems, including tracking software bugs through each phase of development and allowing developers to communicate along the way.

+ Oversaw 20+ volunteers to help produce high-quality audio/visual productions for Sunday services, live events, and other productions.

I get excited about creating software that will have a tangible effect on human lives by making things more efficient and removing distractions. Want to connect? Feel free to contact me at eric.m.lombardo@gmail.com.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
Software engineering program designed to equip students with the skills necessary to thrive in the tech industry upon graduation. With a focus on the fundamentals and breaking each language/framework down, we were able to learn not only the material presented but how to learn any material tech-related.

The program gave us experience with many languages, frameworks, and topics including:
Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, React.js, Redux.js, CSS, HTML, ActiveRecord, OAuth, Git, Github, SQL, Tailwind, Bootstrap, MVC, Single Source of Truth and much more

positions.title: Founder/Owner
positions.description:
+ Created individualized solutions for client's photography and videography needs
+ Troubleshoot issues onsight as they arose during shoots
+ Communicated processes to the client so they understood each step to completion

company.name: Grove City Church of the Nazarene

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
+ Coordinated 20+ volunteers to design high-quality audio/visual elements for a multitude of events 
+ Oversaw the installation, operation, and upkeep of all A/V equipment throughout the facility.
+ Worked with hospitals, news stations, and schools to provide audio/visual solutions for live events

positions.title: Video Production Specialist
positions.description:
+ Built a group of volunteers to shoot/edit promos, music videos, recaps, and other content needed
+ Created videos from inception to completion, including planning, location scouting, organizing talent, shooting, and editing.
+ Mentored high school students to improve them professionally and invent into them personally
